description:
This file defines the ErfC class which provides methods to compute the complementary error function (ERFC) in the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically within the 'Calculation
gineering' namespace. It handles input validation, supports array inputs, and implements the ERFC calculation algorithm.

classes.name: ErfC
classes.description: Provides implementation for the complementary error function (ERFC) calculation within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation engine.

methods.name: ERFC
methods.description: Public method that returns the ERFC value for a given input, supporting both scalar and array inputs.

methods.name: erfcValue
methods.description: Private helper method that computes the ERFC value for a numeric input based on its magnitude, using different calculation strategies.
